i received this product complimentary from MDSolarSciences. this is my first time using a stick sunscreen and i'm so excited about it. i've been wanting to try one for a long time. reapplication is much more convenient this way. i love that this isn't scented and doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell. I've really been enjoying using this sunstick, it gives my skin a nice glow!
Love this easy to use SPF stick. Goes on smooth and is not greasy, and small enough to carry with you for a longer outing in the sun

I'm a big fan of MdSolarSciences. I live in a tropical country and goes on hike, beach and rainforest river cruise for business all the time. I've tried many sunscreen and ever since I tried MdSolarSciences, I stopped trying others. I wouldn't take the trouble ordering them half way around the world if it there is an alternative. This stick sunblock is very convinient to apply and reapply right from the stick. No need a mirror, no need to use my hand. I can easily reapply when I walk, hike or drive. The texture is very light, yet well coverage. I bought the tinted one and it blends in right away. I will repurchase and also the regular one, just because,

I love the convenience of a stick because it makes it easier to apply but for me this stick wasn't the easiest to glide on versus the shiseido sunscreen stick. However, both sticks are VERY different (shiseido is a chemical sunscreen and MDsolarsciences is a physical sunscreen which can sometimes be more chalky). What I didn't like about this product was the shape of the stick. It was dome like which made it so uncomfortable to apply to my forehead because I had to rub it on hard. So it felt like a lacrosse ball gliding on my forehead. It was kinda awkward to apply under the eyes and around the nose but I just used my fingers to grab the product then apply to my face (defeats the point of the stick but applies well on cheeks). Other than that, it was great! It didn't leave a white cast which is a problem I always have with most physical sunscreens and I have olive medium skin. For me, it was more on the matiffying side. I am on accutane and now that my skin is more dry I am experiencing piling. However, if I had gotten the white sunscreen stick instead of the tinted it would've been more multipurpose use around my hands and neck since the tint kinda stains my clothes.

This sunscreen stick is worth every penny. Excellent, Excellent product. There isn't a foul smell to it , it isn't greasy, it's invisible on my skin (I have an olive skin tone so I don't know how this will look on darker skin complexions, but the brown color of the sunscreen is true to the picture), it glides really nicely on the skin, it doesn't irritate or sting my skin which is great because I kinda have sensitive skin, and it has a nice feel to it. I want to buy two more because it's a little small, but I absolutely love this product. I specifically wanted a sunscreen stick because I didn't want to keep washing my hands before re-aaplying sunscreen throughout the day. A sunscreen stick is more convenient. The active ingredients are Titanium Dioxide and Zinc Oxide, and it's cruelty-free which is a PLUS.

This is a really great product and I highly recommend it. It's small enough that I can put it in my purse for touch ups and makes sure I have enough SPF throughout the day. It's a very smooth consistency and glides on great.

I love how flawless this applies onto my skin!! It makes for an effortless application and I can quickly go about my day and be protected. Ease is key. SPF has to be easy to apply or let's be honest - we won't apply it. I love how simple this is to use!

I've never experienced a product quite like this one before! The consistency is smooth and look la so natural on my face. It definitely makes incorporating sunscreen in my routine much easy. Plus it looks great under makeup. This product was gifted by MDSolarSciences

This sunscreen is perfect. I love that I can use it daily and carry it with me EVERYWHERE to touch it up every so often as its size is perfect to go unnoticed. My face doesn't feel sticky at all on the contrary, the finish feels super light and blends in very well. Complimentary from MDSolarScience

Gifted by MDSolarSciences. I love how simple this product is to apply. I just rub the stick onto my face. It's tinted so there's no white cast. I have combination skin and this formula didn't break out my skin. Overall, a beautiful product and I like it so much!

What a great product from MD Solar Science! SPF is so important and this is a great way to make sure I'm wearing it every day. Feels super nice on the skin and sits well under makeup. Highly recommend!!

I really like this sunscreen. It is perfect size to keep in my bag and reapply throughout the day. It doesn't leave strikes and doesn't have a scent which i totally love. It feels super lightweight too.

This is such a great spf. It's very lightweight and it's water resistant. The packaging is great to carry it everywhere. The rounded tip makes it easy to apply top and behind the ears , under eyes and forehead.

I love the texture of this product! Glides on easily and it's small enough that it's easily portable for convenient use and reapplication on the go. No white cast and wears nicely under makeup without oily residue.

This is perfect for on the go and a great size for not taking up much space in my bag which making replying throughout the day easier as it's always on me. The formula is light weight and I like that it can be applied to the cheeks, forehead, lips, and ears!

avis.titre: Great for reapplying on the go!
avis.texte: This is an amazing sunscreen stick. What I love the most is that I can reapply my sunscreen throughout the day without touching my face so it's perfect for on the go.It does not leave a white cast which is impressive for a mineral sunscreen. I like that the applicator is rounded so I can reach areas like around my nose and eyes, and even lips.Highly recommend, it makes reapplying sunscreen easy and convenient and love how compact it is!

I love this stick because I hate putting on liquid sunscreen and this also gives you a bit of a glow and it's super easy to put makeup on top. I had the original stick and not the tinted but I definitely prefer the tinted, no white last at all for me! I also have dry-normal skin and this is amazing hydration too.
It's so light and easy way to re-apply over your makeup. Not clogging my pores and leaves a nice glow.
Smooth, perfect color and my daughters want to use it everyday because it looks like make up!

avis.titre: Best on the go and quick touch up sunscreen and color!
avis.texte: I love this on the go tinted solar stick. It not only provides that extra layer of sun protection over the Mineral Creme, but it provides a hint of sun kissed color. I use it on my eyes, cheeks, lips.

Finally, a sunscreen that I can wear all day and it won't start burning my eyes!! The texture is silky, spreads evenly. A natural, healthy, moist tint...just enough color to smooth out flaws. I wear just a single layer but I'm certain it wouldn't look cakey if applied a little heavier to cover more problematic areas. I love it.

avis.titre: Love how easy this is to use!
avis.texte: I use this mainly to reapply my sun screen daily after I get ready in the morning. It goes on so easily and never looks chalky.
Small and easy to tuck into my purse for reapplications. Effective, of course, and tinted for invisible touch-ups.

avis.titre: I have this in my purse at all times!
avis.texte: I've enjoyed having this smaller sized tinted solar stick! I live on a cold snowy climate in the winter, and my nose seems to run often, so I always have a pack of tissues, and now my sunscreen stick to put back on the sunscreen I see come off while blowing your nose. I hate it when wiped away my runny nose and i could see my tinted Sunscreen come off. It's so easy to grab that stick wipe a bit back on my nose and below my nose. It makes me feel like a new woman.! Goodbye red nose!!

I gave 4 stars because it is quite greasy for my oily/combination skin especially here in texas the weather is hot/humid. Maybe this would be good during colder days. But overall it is great for reapplying and the tint is not too dark and orangey.

avis.titre: Great on the Go SPF Reapplication Option
avis.texte: This is a game changer for SPF reapplication. I am consistent with reapplying my SPF but doing so when out and about has been challenging. This stick requires very little to no rubbing in once I swipe it on. I will advise that I have light skin with warm undertones. My daughter used this and she has darker skin, requiring her to work the product in a bit with her hands. I love the tint myself because it virtually eliminates any pasty white color. The con is the cost and that the nee packaging, while cute does not easily fit into a flat pocket. Regardless I will likely repurchase.

I am so glad i got this! It's super perfect for spf retouch, it fits perfect on my small purses, i super love it, i can re apply my sunscreen anytime anywhere without having to touch my face. Best sunscreen stick ever!
Great product, glides on easily. Just wish there was a smidge more color to the tint. Nice for normal or dry skin. Probably not for oily skin.
I love the formula, even though it feels thick once you put it on, it is light on the skin

avis.titre: The perfect on the go version of the Tinted Creme!
avis.texte: If you love the tinted creme, you'll love this. Hands down, it is always in my purse for on-the-go reapplication. I have super sensitive, acne-prone skin and this helps gives me a flawless glow and also Mineral SPF protection to prevent wrinkles or damage to my acne scarring!
